verification: Read AGENTS.md, automation/README.md, this policy and current schemas before publishing
Read latest source and today records; never duplicate, backfill or future-date without explicit user request
Only edit allowed authoring inputs; no React/CSS/workflow/generated-file edits in a scheduled content task
Commit complete source+catalog atomically with current parent SHA; no force push
Wait for React Pages validation and publication and its public-origin check; report committed, validated, published separately
Never weaken regression checks, overwrite approved snapshots or clear browser state to publish content

contentFeeds.note: All 12 episodes completed. Original schedule paused by user; do not restart. Assets and existing lessons remain preserved.
contentFeeds.visualGuidelines: Each episode: 1-3 original concept illustrations or diagrams where they clarify mechanics. Prefer purposeful labeled SVG for timelines/architecture/comparison; PNG/WebP when detailed artwork materially helps. Provide Korean alt and explanatory caption; link image blocks as /game-design/<episode>/assets/<filename>. Include visual sources if adapted; do not reuse copyrighted game screenshots without rights.

healthChecks.purpose: Verify today's thinking lesson and React Pages publication; re-enable accidentally disabled 06:00 task and repair only if today's content is missing, never double-publish.
Inspect latest source, React validation and live Pages source identity; diagnose and repair authorized publication failures without duplicate lesson authoring or bypassing checks.

failurePolicy.thinking: Never self-disable on GitHub update_ref/PR or React Pages failure. Preserve actionable error details; 07:00 watchdog verifies the catalog, current KST date, source file, deployment and primary scheduler enabled status.
failurePolicy.publication: Prefer atomic create_tree/create_commit/update_ref(expected_sha). If GitHub safely permits a non-atomic Contents API recovery, write source first, verify it, then catalog; do not claim publication until both files and React Pages validation succeed. Never force-push or modify generated UI.

scheduleMigration.note: Replacement schedules were created and enabled. Actual automation tool state is authoritative; repository metadata does not execute schedules.
